name: Cursed Tools
description: Cursed tools of every kind: the weapon line uses vanilla weapon logic (infinite durability, +6 damage against the undead, each with its own signature ability), while the curio line (the mask, the Life Lamp Ring, the Planetarium and so on) does not - each has its own use instead. All of them count as cursed tools and are confiscated by Fukuma Mizushi's verdict.
